answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable bond, released only after twenty graded jobs clear their dispute window. One bond is cheap. A farm spinning up a thousand accounts must lock a thousand bonds at once, and every proven fake burns its bond before rewards vest. Identities stop being seeds scattered free across a dune. Each one is a juniper stake planted with real money, pulled up when it rots. Grader attention, scarce as saffron, then flows only to work backed by a stake.
